# Findings: local certificate utility commands in smallstep `step`

All subcommands of `step certificate` are registered at `command/certificate/certificate.go:84-98` (bundle, create, format, inspect, fingerprint, lint, needs-renewal, sign, verify, key, install, uninstall, p12).

## 1. `command/certificate/bundle.go`
- Simple concatenation: exactly 3 positional args `<crt-file> <ca> <bundle-file>` (bundle.go:55). Reads each file, PEM-decodes only the *first* block (bundle.go:64, 74), writes leaf PEM followed by CA PEM to the bundle with mode 0600 (bundle.go:80-83).
- Order is **leaf-first, issuer second** — no chain building, no validation of the relationship, no `$STEP`/dir interpolation (plain `os.ReadFile`). Only flag: `--force` (bundle.go:50).

## 2. `command/certificate/inspect.go`
- Local file or remote URL (STDIN with `-`, inspect.go:200-202). Remote detection via `trimURL` and TLS dial in `command/certificate/remote.go:35-95`; port prefixes: tcp/tls/https 443, smtps 465, ldaps 636 (remote.go:15-21).
- `--format text|json|pem`, default text (inspect.go:130-146, 204-206). `--short` only valid with text (207-209). Text output uses `certinfo.CertificateText/ShortText` (253-267); JSON uses **zcrypto** `zx509.ParseCertificate` then JSON-encodes (268-293); PEM re-encodes raw certs (294-301).
- Default prints only the **first** certificate; `--bundle` prints all in file order (219-222, 241-244). CSR detection fallback when no CERTIFICATE blocks (229-237). Remote flags: `--roots` (file, comma-separated list, or directory — via `x509util.ReadCertPool`), `--servername`, `--insecure` (inspect.go:147-179; remote.go:40-58).

## 3. `command/certificate/fingerprint.go`
- Default hash **SHA-256** (fingerprint.go:169); `--sha1` exists but requires `--insecure` (126-128, 170-172).

## 5. `command/certificate/verify.go`
- Pure local RFC 5280 path validation with `crypto/x509`: first PEM block = leaf, all remaining CERTIFICATE blocks become the intermediates pool (verify.go:195-220); `cert.Verify` with `KeyUsages: ExtKeyUsageAny` (231-244).
